introduction.purpose: The Online Banking Application is an educational simulation developed to demonstrate a coherent, traceable software development lifecycle. This Business Requirements Document specifies, in user/business language, what the business wants the system to do. It is the primary deliverable of the business-analysis stage and forms the basis for the Functional Requirements Document (FRD) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
introduction.scope: This BRD covers the business requirements for the Online Banking Application educational simulation as bounded by the project charter and the scope agreement. It defines the business capabilities, business rules, constraints, assumptions, and open questions. It does not specify technical implementation.
audience: Human reviewers and approvers of business requirements

project_drivers.purpose_of_application: Customers expect secure digital access to banking capabilities, including accounts, transfers, and statements. The project delivers a coherent online-banking simulation using synthetic data, coordinated across business analysis, architecture, development, testing, and defect root-cause analysis, supported by reusable AI-assisted engineering agents. Success requires demonstrating that an approved business rule can be traced through requirement, design element, implementation, test, defect decision, and final evidence record.

stakeholders.role: Turn approved needs into a Business Requirements Document.
Technical design, build, and unit testing.

users_of_application.description: Completes onboarding, provides KYC and Aadhaar/PAN information, activates an account, logs in/out, transfers and receives simulated money, and views/downloads statements.
Reviews KYC, sets KYC status, activates/freezes accounts, views customer account state, accesses the audit trail, and logs in/out.

key_success_factors: A coherent banking simulation using synthetic identities, accounts, balances, beneficiaries, and payments.
Role-based customer and bank-operations journeys with auditable state changes.
Agent output that is reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval.
Traceability of approved business rules through requirement, design, implementation, test, and evidence.
Application of security, privacy, accessibility, reliability, and testability as acceptance conditions.
Governance through baselines, versioning, change control, traceability, evidence, risk management, and retrospectives.

constraints.description: The system is an educational simulation, not a production banking system.
Real money movement is not permitted; money movement is simulated using synthetic data.
Real identity verification is not permitted; Aadhaar/PAN verification is format-only and mocked.
Production bank integration is not permitted, including real payment gateways and external KYC integrations.
Business requirements must not invent business decisions not present in the source material.

assumptions_and_dependencies.description: The project uses synthetic identities, accounts, balances, beneficiaries, and payments throughout the simulation.
The system supports two user roles: Customer and Bank Operations.
All agent-produced artifacts are reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval.
Candidate in-scope business areas are subject to detailed requirement confirmation and human approval before being treated as approved requirements.
Aadhaar/PAN verification is format-only and mocked; no real identity verification is performed.

current_state.stakeholder_problem: Customers expect secure digital access to onboarding, accounts, transfers, statements, and related banking functions. Student projects can treat business analysis, architecture, engineering, testing, evidence management, and defect triage as isolated activities, which can result in ambiguous requirements, untestable designs, weak handoffs, and disagreement over whether a failure is a defect or a new request.
current_state.existing_business_environment: No detailed description of an existing business environment is provided in the source material. The project is a new educational simulation and is not based on an existing production banking system.
current_state.existing_application_environment: No existing application environment is described in the source material. The application is greenfield for the purposes of this simulation.

stakeholder_profiles.name: Customer
stakeholder_profiles.description: An end user of the online banking simulation who manages their own onboarding, KYC, account activation, transactions, and statements.
success_criteria: Can complete onboarding and provide KYC and Aadhaar/PAN information.
Can activate an account and log in/out.
Can transfer and receive simulated money.
deliverables: Provision of KYC and Aadhaar/PAN information.

stakeholder_profiles.name: Bank Operations
stakeholder_profiles.description: A bank-operations user who administers customer accounts and KYC within the simulation.
success_criteria: Can review KYC and set KYC status.
Can activate and freeze customer accounts.
deliverables: Review and update of KYC status.
Activation and freezing of customer accounts.

included: KYC information capture (format-only, mocked for Aadhaar/PAN)
Bank operations: review KYC, set KYC status, activate/freeze accounts, view customer account state, access audit trail, login/logout
Role-based access for customer and bank-operations journeys

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to complete onboarding.
requirements.rationale: Onboarding is a core customer journey required for the simulation.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to provide KYC information.
requirements.rationale: KYC information is required as part of the customer journey.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to provide Aadhaar and PAN information. Verification of Aadhaar/PAN is format-only and mocked.
requirements.rationale: Aadhaar/PAN details are captured for the simulation but are not verified against any real authority.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to activate an account.
requirements.rationale: Account activation is a required customer capability.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to log in.
requirements.rationale: Customer login provides role-based access to the application.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to log out.
requirements.rationale: Customer logout terminates the customer session.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to transfer simulated money.
requirements.rationale: Money movement is simulated using synthetic data.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to receive simulated money.
requirements.rationale: Money movement is simulated using synthetic data.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to view statements.
requirements.rationale: Statement viewing is a required customer capability.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a customer to download statements.
requirements.rationale: Statement download is a required customer capability.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to review KYC information.
requirements.rationale: Bank operations administer KYC within the simulation.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to set KYC status.
requirements.rationale: Bank operations administer KYC status.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to activate customer accounts.
requirements.rationale: Account activation is a bank-operations administrative capability.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to freeze customer accounts.
requirements.rationale: Account freezing is a bank-operations administrative capability.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to view customer account state.
requirements.rationale: Bank operations require visibility into customer account state.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to access the audit trail.
requirements.rationale: Audit trail access supports auditable state changes.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to log in.
requirements.rationale: Bank-operations login provides role-based access.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow bank operations to log out.
requirements.rationale: Bank-operations logout terminates the session.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide role-based access so that customer and bank-operations journeys are kept distinct.
requirements.rationale: Role-based access is a stated project objective.

requirements.statement: The system shall make state changes auditable.
requirements.rationale: Auditable state changes are a stated project success criterion.

requirements.statement: The system shall use synthetic identities, accounts, balances, beneficiaries, and payments for the simulation.
requirements.rationale: The project is an educational simulation using synthetic data.

requirements.statement: Agent-produced artifacts shall be reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval.
requirements.rationale: Reviewable and source-linked agent output is a stated project objective.

requirements.statement: Approved business rules shall remain traceable through requirements and downstream evidence.
requirements.rationale: Traceability is a stated governance and success requirement.

business_rules.rule: The simulation must not use real money; money movement is simulated using synthetic data.
The simulation must not perform real identity verification; Aadhaar/PAN verification is format-only and mocked.
The system must not perform credit decisioning, lending, or real financial transactions.
The system must not integrate with production banks, real payment gateways, or external KYC integrations.
The system supports two distinct roles: Customer and Bank Operations, with role-based access.
State changes in the system must be auditable.
Any requirement outside the approved scope must be handled through the project's change-control process rather than silently added to the baseline.
Every project handoff must carry version, source IDs, assumptions, open questions, and approval status.

open_questions.question: Who executes UAT and signs off business acceptance?
What is the minimum balance value?
What is the daily transfer cap?
Is the data-testid convention confirmed with the development team?
What are the exact onboarding workflow and validation rules?
What are the exact account operations and account-state rules?
What are the exact transfer/payment rules and limits?
What are the statement content and download behaviour details?
What are the exact role permissions and authorization rules?
What are the detailed security, privacy, accessibility, and testability requirements?
What are the exact audit events to be recorded?
What are the error codes and error messages?
What are the data fields and validation constraints?
